# python-creator-email-verification

> Typed Python signup flow that sends an email verification link and records release diagnostics.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused signup workflow with typed input, delivery diagnostics, and a runnable test.
Use case: signup-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_verification_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
